scientific_integrity: Uses and credits source exact area formulas, classical Dowker convexity and published tiling transfer. Exact-rational verification of all finite inequalities is included. No claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Regular even-sided polygonal norm balls; weak rather than full Dowker convexity; normal convex unit-area tilings; absence of an exceptional weak certificate does not settle exceptional honeycomb properties; no independent audit or absolute priority certification.
title: The zero-exponent Dowker dichotomy for regular even polygons and logarithmic honeycomb tilings
